rules.problem: Structure (unable to open mouth OR sudden swelling AND any of) is faithful.

Page's 'anaemia likely' (Hb <12 g/dL woman, <13 g/dL man) with sex-specific thresholds is not encoded; also no rule for 'swelling of lips' or abacavir hypersensitivity reaction checks (cross-references).

summary: Most consequential: the impetigo rule wrongly requires an angle-of-mouth fissure and the oesophageal candida rule wrongly requires white patches, so both would under-fire versus the page. The aphthous rule fires on any mouth ulcer and the anaemia (Hb threshold) diagnosis is not encoded. Anaphylaxis and urgent rules are structurally faithful, though the 'within the past few hours' exposure window is dropped.
